reason: The editor agent tools' dependency resolver moved from lib/claude/plugin-tool-ipc.ts into the codeserver module (lib/codeserver/agent-tools.ts, ADR-0250 §14 tools contribution). It reads the same project store (the projects a session's execution root is resolved against) it read there; plugin-tool-ipc stays a member for its other reads, so the move counts one new file. Repaid when the session's execution root reaches the family through an injected interface instead of the store.
